```{r library}
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(here)
library(readr)
library(openxlsx)
```

```{r convert}
# Function to convert Excel files to CSV
convert_excel_to_csv <- function(folder_path) {
  # Get the absolute path to the folder
  abs_folder_path <- here(folder_path)

  # Get list of all Excel files in the folder
  excel_files <- list.files(path = abs_folder_path, pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)

  # Loop through each Excel file
  for (excel_file in excel_files) {
    # Read the Excel file with all columns as text to avoid type issues
    excel_data <- read_excel(excel_file, col_types = "text")

    # Create CSV file name by replacing .xlsx with .csv
    csv_file <- sub("\\.xlsx$", ".csv", excel_file)

    # Write the data to CSV file, leaving NA values as blanks
    write.csv(excel_data, file = csv_file, row.names = FALSE, na = "")

    # Print a message to indicate successful conversion
    cat("Converted:", excel_file, "to", csv_file, "\n")
  }
}

# Specify the folder containing Excel files relative to your project directory
folder_path <- "upload-libraries/Excel"

# Call the function to convert Excel files to CSV
convert_excel_to_csv(folder_path)
```

```{r export column names}
# Directory containing the CSV files
csv_directory <- here("upload-libraries/Excel")

# Output Excel file
output_excel_file <- here("upload-libraries/Excel/output.xlsx")

# Create a new workbook
wb <- createWorkbook()

# Get the list of CSV files in the directory
csv_files <- list.files(csv_directory, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)

# Iterate over each CSV file
for (csv_file in csv_files) {
  # Read the CSV file
  df <- read_csv(csv_file)

  # Get the column names
  column_names <- data.frame(Column_Names = colnames(df))

  # Extract the base name of the file for the sheet name
  sheet_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(csv_file))

  # Add a sheet to the workbook
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)

  # Write the column names to the sheet
  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = column_names)
}

# Save the workbook
saveWorkbook(wb, output_excel_file, overwrite = TRUE)

cat("Column names have been exported to", output_excel_file)
```

```{r merge csvs}
# Directory containing the CSV files
csv_directory <- here("upload-libraries/Excel")

# Output Excel file
output_excel_file <- here("upload-libraries/Excel/merged_output.xlsx")

# Create a new workbook
wb <- createWorkbook()

# Get the list of CSV files in the directory
csv_files <- list.files(csv_directory, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)

# Iterate over each CSV file
for (csv_file in csv_files) {
  # Read the CSV file
  df <- read_csv(csv_file)

  # Extract the base name of the file for the sheet name
  sheet_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(csv_file))

  # Add a sheet to the workbook
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)

  # Write the data to the sheet
  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = df)
}

# Save the workbook
saveWorkbook(wb, output_excel_file, overwrite = TRUE)

cat("Data from all CSV files have been merged into", output_excel_file)
```
